description: SummitFlow-owned migration secret table. st service rebuild gives a project's Alembic run only the keys listed here, read only from the listed sources: shared = ~/.env.local, project = the project's own env files, backend/.env = its backend env file. A project repo cannot widen this; each key belongs to exactly one project. database_key receives st db's ST_DB_MIGRATION_URL. Unlisted projects get DATABASE_URL from their own env files.
